# Radoslav Radev Recommends Active Recovery On Rest Days Instead Of Full Rest

Radoslav Radev recommends that if you train four times per week, you can make rest days active recovery instead of full rest. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 09:05]

## Details

- If you train four times per week, you have three rest days per week; some of these rest days can be active recovery instead of full rest. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 09:05]
- Active recovery can be running, lower progressions on the skills, balance work like five or ten attempts of handstand, some pull-ups, dips, push-ups, without tiring yourself. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 09:20]
- The next day when you train, your body will be activated and you will have completely different results compared to laying in bed and doing nothing. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 09:38]
- His advice is swimming, running, dips, pull-ups, push-ups, a couple of sets like one or two sets, not too much. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 10:12]

## Evidence

- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 09:05 (Radoslav Radev): "if you train four times per week for the week you have three rest days two of these three race days you can make them instead of full rest you can do active recovery"
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 09:20 (Radoslav Radev): "an active recovery is to do some activity during your rest day this activity can be running lower progressions on the skills balance work let's say you can do a couple of attempts of handstand like five ten attempts of handstand some pull-ups dips push-ups and don't target yourself"
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 09:38 (Radoslav Radev): "the next day when you train your body will be activated and you will have completely different results and i can promise you that instead of just laying on the bed and just don't do anything your body's starting to sleep"
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 10:12 (Radoslav Radev): "my advice for you is swimming running dips pull-ups push-ups not that much couple of sets like one two sets and i promise you the next workouts they will be much more productive"

## Connected Ideas

- [[Radoslav Radev Advises Never Going To Failure Every Workout]] — active recovery supports the nervous system recovery needed between limit sessions.
- [[Radoslav Radev Recommends The Grease The Groove Method Of Spreading Attempts Across The Day]] — both methods spread activity across the day rather than concentrating it.
